s.how: Boil 3 eggs for 10 minutes, then mash with 2 tbsp mayonnaise and cress. Butter 12 slices white bread. Make 2 sandwiches with thin cucumber, 2 with the egg, and 2 with 100g smoked salmon on 100g cream cheese. Cut off the crusts and cut each into 3 fingers.

s.note: Michael's cover story, Mickey Blue Eyes from Kansas City
s.how: Dip 400g fresh ricotta ravioli in 2 beaten eggs, then in 120g breadcrumbs. Fry at 180C in batches for 2 minutes until crisp and golden, then drain. Shower with 30g grated parmesan and serve with 300ml warm passata seasoned with salt and oregano for dipping.

m.note: Gina's dad's restaurant, where the family drops in
m.how: Soak 1kg clams in salted water for 30 minutes to purge. Gently fry 4 sliced garlic cloves and a pinch of chilli in 60ml olive oil, add the clams and 150ml white wine, cover and steam 4 minutes until open. Cook 400g linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan juices and toss with chopped parsley and more olive oil.

w.note: Michael's accent lesson, say it slower
w.how: Whisk 4 egg yolks with 100g caster sugar until pale, then fold in 500g mascarpone and 4 egg whites whipped stiff. Mix 300ml strong espresso with 3 tbsp marsala. Dip 24 savoiardi biscuits quickly and layer with the cream in a dish. Dust with 2 tbsp cocoa and chill overnight.

d.n: Auction house gin and elderflower collins
d.note: for Michael, a very nervous English auctioneer
d.how: Peel 8 long ribbons from 1 Lebanese cucumber and curl two into each of 4 tall glasses, then fill with ice. Shake 160ml gin, 60ml elderflower cordial and 60ml lemon juice with ice for 10 seconds. Strain over the glasses and top each with 100ml soda water. Add a sprig of mint and serve.
